limits: These snapshots reproduce the published sanitized record. Account identifiers, signed polling material and credentials are redacted; selected headers and parsed JSON bodies are retained, not all wire bytes.

Command descriptions and step ordering come from the frozen runner. The original record has exit codes and durations but no command arguments or per-command start/end timestamps. ARM exchanges do have recorded UTC timestamps.

No per-stage Terraform state files, saved plan JSON, console screenshots or full command logs are included in this published evidence. A stage without an ARM exchange is marked as such, without inventing a remote-state snapshot.
Direct probes retain response status/body but not request headers, request bodies or timestamps. Cleanup retains result flags rather than a complete verification exchange.

The targets ran sequentially on one host. Command durations include container/provider overhead and are not a performance comparison. Identity token acquisition and provider downloads are outside ARM capture.
This is one Terraform/AzAPI empty-group lifecycle. It does not establish other providers, other IaC tools, invalid-input behavior, data-plane behavior or cross-service event delivery.

stages.title: Check the group does not exist
stages.commandFromFrozenRunner: Direct GET of the generated resource-group path
stages.purpose: Refuse to modify an existing group. This is a runner probe, outside Terraform.

error.message: Resource group '<group>' could not be found.

differences.azure: Resource group '<group>' could not be found.

stages.title: Check Terraform version
stages.purpose: Check the pinned Terraform 1.17.1 executable.

stages.title: Check configuration format
stages.purpose: Check HCL formatting without changing the source.

stages.title: Initialize the working directory
stages.purpose: Install the pinned provider and initialize Terraform. Provider downloads are outside ARM capture.

stages.title: Validate configuration
stages.purpose: Validate the configuration using the installed provider.

stages.title: Plan creation
stages.purpose: Plan the new group with revision=one. Expected exit 2 means changes are planned.

stages.title: Create the group
stages.purpose: Create and read the group. Apply computes its own plan; this run did not apply a saved plan file.

error.message: Resource group '<group>' could not be found.

differences.azure: Resource group '<group>' could not be found.

stages.title: Check for an empty plan
stages.purpose: Read the group and check that no change is needed.

stages.title: Refresh Terraform state
stages.purpose: Refresh state from the remote group without requesting a configuration change.

stages.title: Plan a tag update
stages.purpose: The runner changes the external revision input from one to two. HCL source remains unchanged.

stages.title: Apply the tag update
stages.purpose: Update the desired revision tag to two and read back the group.

stages.title: Verify the update independently
stages.commandFromFrozenRunner: Direct GET of the resource-group path
stages.purpose: Check revision=two outside the native provider trace.

stages.title: Introduce external drift
stages.commandFromFrozenRunner: Direct PATCH with existing tags and revision=external
stages.purpose: Intentionally change the remote tag without changing Terraform inputs. This is a test action, not a Terraform deployment step.

stages.title: Detect the external drift
stages.purpose: Read revision=external and plan to restore the desired revision=two.

stages.title: Repair the drift
stages.purpose: Restore the desired tag and read back the group.

stages.title: Verify the repair independently
stages.commandFromFrozenRunner: Direct GET of the resource-group path
stages.purpose: Check revision=two outside the native provider trace.

stages.title: Remove Terraform ownership
stages.purpose: Remove the resource from Terraform state without deleting the remote group.

stages.title: Import the existing group
stages.purpose: Reattach the existing group to Terraform state. The recorded provider requests use API version 2025-04-01.

stages.title: Check the imported state
stages.purpose: Check that no change is needed after import. Retain both observed API versions.

stages.title: Destroy the group
stages.purpose: Read and delete the group. Preserve the different deletion responses and Azure polling request.

stages.title: Confirm absence and remove private files
stages.commandFromFrozenRunner: Independent cleanup verification and private-file removal
stages.purpose: The cleanup record reports confirmed absence and removal of credentials, certificates and state. It does not contain the full verification HTTP exchange.
